job.title: IT Support Engineer I, eero
job.pay_full: $33.26 – $49.51 an hour base pay (San Francisco, CA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon's eero team (Devices Hardware & eero) is hiring an IT Support Engineer I in San Francisco to deliver reliable technology support: putting technical solutions in place and supporting computer hardware, operating systems and enterprise software. You will troubleshoot and fix problems, sometimes without a ready-made playbook, keeping teams productive and systems available.
duties: Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, networking and operating system issues, finding root causes and limiting the impact on users
Run local IT projects: define requirements, track progress, clear blockers and deliver results
Write and maintain knowledge base articles, procedures and user documentation for technical and non-technical readers
Spot inefficient processes and automate tasks through scripting and changes to local tools
Coordinate change management, act as an escalation point for support associates and help with new technology deployments
needs: 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repair
2+ years supporting Windows, Mac or Linux operating systems in a corporate setting
1+ years supporting identity and access management platforms such as Okta, including single sign-on and multifactor authentication
Hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS devices, with working knowledge of Windows
Experience supporting productivity and collaboration platforms and administering user accounts and permissions
nice: Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
Experience finding root causes, improving support workflows and writing technical documentation
Experience coordinating employee onboarding, hardware refreshes and other local IT projects
details.benefits: Base pay $33.26 – $49.51 an hour (San Francisco, CA). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the application and hiring process for candidates with disabilities
